QuestInfo.name: Collecting 200 Cursed Dolls
QuestInfo.parent: Rowen the Fairy and the Cursed Doll
QuestInfo.1: Rowen asks for your help one last time, this time to collect #b200 Cursed Dolls#k. You wonder why she needs so many... Is she trying to sell them or something?
QuestInfo.2: You eliminated a bunch of Zombie Lupins in a forest near Ellinia and collected all #b200 Cursed Dolls#k for Rowen. In return, she gave you a nice hat. You've collected so many dolls for her, but it seems like the Zombie Lupins aren't decreasing in any way, shape, or form... you wonder what's going on. However, it seems that the fairies may not have such animosity toward humans now... at least that's a good thing.

0.0: Traveler, you've returned...again. I'm sorry to keep asking you, but I need you to bring me more #t4000031#s. This is the last time, I promise. Can you bring me 200 #b#t4000031#s#k?

yes.0: Thank you so much. The #o4230101#s are often seen in the Dark Tree Forest near #m101000000#. Just bring me #b200 #k #b#t4000031#s#k.

no.0: I see... I thought I could count on you for this, but if you are busy, then it's understandable. Please come back if you ever have a change of heart in the near future.

1.0: This is... Wow! You've brought me 200 #t4000031#s! That means you've thinned out the #o4230101#s. But it's too early to be relieved, because this doll is capable of continuously making new puppets.
1.1: Oh yeah, take this as a token of my appreciation. The fairies will spread word of your good deed. I personally think you deserve to be called a hero, and not just because you save me from a pickle!

yes.0: I have increased your fame a little. I am also giving you this hat made with fairy magic. Please put it to good use. Thank you so much for your help.
yes.1: Maybe fairies are unfairly prejudiced against humans. I'm confident that you'll protect this forest for all of us. Well then, so long...

item.0: So, you weren't able to collect 200 #b#t4000031#s#k yet. The #t4000031# is making more Puppets of itself as we speak. You need to hurry up and bring me the dolls.
